trigger_condition: Identity and constant returns earn U without establishing a hidden obligation.
guard_snippet: Separate outcome/relevance evidence from hidden-responsibility credit; explicitly decide the intended identity/constant-return baseline.
potential_consequence: The identity case gets H=1 and scores 47 despite hiding no recognized computation, state, policy or lifecycle obligation.

trigger_condition: Distinct public roots share the same underlying responsibility.
guard_snippet: Deduplicate obligation identities by boundary, governed root/outcome and category; retain families as access routes. Add shared-state source fixtures.
potential_consequence: The same validation, state or synchronization obligation earns credit per public root, contrary to the overview at lines 110-112.

trigger_condition: A primitive arithmetic wrapper and a substantial pure computation have the same category vector.
guard_snippet: Add contrasting pure-computation source fixtures. Either accept and prominently document the resolution limit, or recognize a small capped set of independent transformation obligations; do not count operators or loops.
potential_consequence: Both receive U+2X and score 23 for the example signature, while state and synchronization earn additional credit. This limits fidelity to useful hidden functionality.

trigger_condition: Fully resolved dispatch alternatives hide different responsibility categories.
guard_snippet: Retain bounded alternative vectors or derive a supported minimum H across alternatives; specify deduplication and conservative fallback at the alternative cap.
potential_consequence: One U+C implementation and one U+X implementation each have H=3, but category intersection yields H=1 and changes an otherwise identical score from 23 to 47.

trigger_condition: Equivalent creation APIs use explicit constructors, implicit constructors or factories.
guard_snippet: Define language-neutral creation facts and fixtures covering all three; consistently distinguish allocation from meaningful transformation.
potential_consequence: Explicit constructors add O, implicit constructors lack a rule, and factory record construction can earn U/X while constructor-only objects are inapplicable.

trigger_condition: Equivalent optional inputs are parameters or record fields.
guard_snippet: Separate required supplied slots from optional exposed choices and apply the distinction consistently across both representations.
potential_consequence: All declared parameters count toward A; optional record fields do not. Packaging alone changes caller burden.

trigger_condition: A source-local enum or Boolean selects policy without a callback or registry policy position.
guard_snippet: Specify a bounded recognizer for resolved public-input-controlled behavior selection, with negative data-transformation controls.
potential_consequence: Caller policy decisions are omitted depending on implementation syntax.

trigger_condition: Unchanged boundaries move between files or acquire a different namespace anchor.
guard_snippet: Compute aggregate SHALLOW contribution using stable boundary identities; project maxima onto files only for navigation. Add regrouping and anchor-move tests.
potential_consequence: File maxima collapse contributions when boundaries share a file, allowing SCORE improvement from a navigation-only edit.

trigger_condition: Adapters begin implementation without a shared flow semantics contract.
guard_snippet: Specify normalized alias roots, bindings, exceptional exits, joins, ownership transfer and provenance; provide source-to-flow-to-fact fixtures before independent adapter work.
potential_consequence: Scorer fixtures can pass while equivalent source produces incompatible facts in different languages.

trigger_condition: Registry implementers must decide overload effects, aliasing, exceptional exits and policy positions.
guard_snippet: Supply concrete initial registry entries and positive/negative source fixtures as policy artifacts.
potential_consequence: The allegedly fixed policy still leaves scoring and eligibility decisions to implementation.

trigger_condition: Many boundaries share large helper graphs or recursive summaries accumulate bindings.
guard_snippet: Bound summary cardinality, retained bytes, instantiated bindings and artifact-wide work; intern shared evidence and benchmark fan-in, diamonds, deep chains and SCCs.
potential_consequence: Per-boundary limits and two workers do not bound aggregate work or memory; independent-package smoke data misses these costs.

trigger_condition: Benchmark timings or memory regress without causing whole-workspace reanalysis.
guard_snippet: Define explicit startup, warm/edit latency and peak-memory acceptance budgets for a stated benchmark environment, separate from deterministic unit tests.
potential_consequence: Recording performance alone permits an arbitrarily expensive implementation to satisfy completion criteria.

trigger_condition: A convenience overload supplies a previously mandatory policy default.
guard_snippet: Add a monotonicity source fixture and define route-aware burden: distinguish required decisions on a usable route from optional surface choices.
potential_consequence: With H=3, O=1,T=2,A=2,P=1 scores 37; adding a one-argument default overload yields O=2,T=2,A=3,P=0 and scores 38. Removing a caller obligation worsens SHALLOW. This overlaps the parameter-packaging issue but is a distinct counterexample.

trigger_condition: Validated and unvalidated public routes share a delegated service family.
potential_consequence: A validated route can credit responsibility to an unvalidated route.

trigger_condition: Equivalent behavior uses an explicit conditional instead of finite receiver dispatch.
guard_snippet: Specify category-specific CFG joins and assert equivalence to receiver joins.
potential_consequence: Equivalent control flow can receive different responsibility facts.

trigger_condition: Two unchanged boundaries move from separate files into one file.
guard_snippet: Aggregate by stable boundary identity before projecting onto files.
potential_consequence: Maximum-per-file aggregation removes a contribution without changing the contracts.

trigger_condition: Cached shared summaries exceed a boundary’s cold-analysis work budget.
guard_snippet: Charge deterministic logical costs independently of cache residency and scheduling.
potential_consequence: Warm and cold runs may disagree on numeric eligibility.

trigger_condition: Recursive substitution grows access paths or calling contexts.
guard_snippet: Define a finite abstract domain, bounded paths/contexts, join order and widening to unknown.
potential_consequence: Fixed-point results depend on implementation-specific truncation or budget exhaustion.

trigger_condition: One worklist update processes a large alias or binding set.
guard_snippet: Charge element visits; cap summary cardinality and evidence payload size.
potential_consequence: Update-count limits allow large CPU and memory consumption.
